mapper.select: SELECT id, product_key, model_json, version, created_at, updated_at FROM iot_thing_model WHERE product_key = #{productKey} ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO iot_thing_model(product_key, model_json, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{productKey}, #{modelJson}, #{version}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
